# Spaces Designer Homes

> Boutique custom homes, additions and remodels across Grand Rapids and the West Michigan lakeshore.

Spaces Designer Homes designs and builds fully custom homes, additions and remodels across West Michigan. An in-house designer, our own showroom and one dedicated team handle design, budgeting, selections and construction, so every decision is settled before we break ground.

- Phone: 616-682-7119
- Email: info@spacesdesignerhomes.com
- Studio: 3624 29th St SE, #A, Grand Rapids, Michigan 49512

## Common questions

### How much does a custom home cost in West Michigan?

A nicely appointed 3,000 square foot custom home typically runs around $750,000 all-in, including design, site costs and finishes. We give you a clear picture of where your budget goes before you commit to anything.

### How long does it take to build?

Plan on 8 to 12 months of construction for a fully custom home, with design and selections adding time up front depending on how quickly decisions come together.

### Do you charge by the square foot?

No. We price what actually goes into the home, not just the footprint, and break it down in plain numbers.

### Do you do additions and remodels too?

Yes. Kitchens, baths, additions and whole-home renovations, at all price points.

### Can I visit the job site?

Yes, and we encourage it. We just ask that visits be scheduled with our construction team for safety.

### What happens after I move in?

Our Keyholder Program: seasonal check-ins, a one-year walkthrough we schedule for you, and a direct line to the people who built your home for as long as you own it.
